clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Dark Cleric Beryl guides newly awakened undead priests in the shadows. Stationed in the Gallows' End Tavern, he teaches them shadow magic and helps them adapt to their unholy existence under the Dark Lady.

Dark Cleric Beryl mentors new Forsaken priests upstairs in Brill's Gallows' End Tavern. He teaches that a priest's power comes from darkness and shadow, yet mastering the dark also requires knowing the light. Newly risen priests turn their focus to shadow and the dark arts under his guidance. Their early trials include crafting their Garments of Darkness and proving their dedication to this new path.
